items.title: Target (TGT) Launches First Good & Gather Cookbook With 100 Recipes
items.summary: Target (NYSE:TGT) has introduced its first Good & Gather cookbook, featuring 100 recipes built around the owned food and beverage brand. The cookbook showcases dishes developed by Target’s in-house test kitchen and is positioned to support the company’s food discovery ambitions. This launch expands Target’s merchandising presence in grocery and ties into its broader multibillion-dollar owned brand goals.
